fah-642.title: Ten-Minute Cake
fah-642.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-642.culturalNotes: Serve with tea or Nescafé. Cool fully before cutting or it crumbles.

instructions.1: Bring all ingredients to room temperature.
instructions.2: Blend the eggs, yogurt, oil, vanilla and salt.
instructions.3: Add the sugar and blend for a minute or two.
instructions.4: Sift the flour with the baking powder over the liquids and whisk one way.
instructions.5: Heat the oven to 170°C and line a 26 cm tin.
instructions.6: Pour in the batter, holding back two tablespoons.
instructions.7: Mix the reserved batter with a tablespoon of raw cocoa, adding two spoons of milk if thick.
instructions.8: Pipe it in a bag to draw a grid pattern over the cake.
instructions.9: Bake on the middle shelf for 45 minutes.
instructions.10: Test with a toothpick after 35 minutes — clean means done.

fah-643.title: Cold Cream-Caramel Cake
fah-643.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-643.culturalNotes: Any favourite biscuits work. Add a little vanilla for flavour.

instructions.1: Break the biscuits into large pieces.
instructions.2: Pour the caramel pack into a kilo of cold milk.
instructions.3: Add two tablespoons each of instant coffee, raw cocoa, cornflour and sugar.
instructions.4: Stir well in the cold milk.
instructions.5: Heat until boiling, then lower and keep stirring until thick.
instructions.6: Pour over the broken biscuits in a Pyrex dish.
instructions.7: Cover and refrigerate until cold.
instructions.8: Turn out onto a serving plate and dust with raw cocoa.
instructions.9: Serve cold.

fah-644.title: No-Oven Cake
fah-644.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-644.culturalNotes: Serve plain or with chocolate or any other sauce. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the eggs with the vanilla and sugar.
instructions.2: Add the oil and mix.
instructions.3: Add the milk and mix until combined.
instructions.4: Add the flour, baking powder, cocoa and salt and mix until smooth.
instructions.5: Grease the tin lightly — or with ghee and flour if aluminium.
instructions.6: Pour in the batter, keeping it under half the tin.
instructions.7: Set the tin in a pot of boiling water reaching a third of its height.
instructions.8: Cover the pot with a towel then a lid and cook over medium heat for 40 minutes.
instructions.9: After 40 minutes, test the cake by inserting a wooden skewer in the center; if it comes out clean, the cake is done.
instructions.10: Lift the cake out, cool slightly, then turn onto a flat surface.
instructions.11: Serve hot or cold with chocolate or any sauce.

fah-645.title: No-Bake Marble Mousse Cake
fah-645.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-645.culturalNotes: Any biscuits work. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the milk, sugar, raw cocoa, cornflour, cream caramel, dark chocolate and instant coffee in a pot.
instructions.2: Stir until combined.
instructions.3: Heat, stirring constantly, until boiling.
instructions.4: Pour into moulds, tucking in pieces of tea biscuits.
instructions.5: Cover and refrigerate 5–6 hours until set.
instructions.6: Unmould with a quick dip in hot water.
instructions.7: Serve cold.

fah-646.title: Diet Chocolate Mug Cakes
fah-646.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-646.culturalNotes: Regular vegetable oil can replace the coconut oil. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the cocoa with the oat flour, bicarbonate, baking powder and sweetener.
instructions.2: Add the laban, vinegar and coconut oil to the dry mix and stir well.
instructions.3: Fill the mugs half-full.
instructions.4: Set the mugs in a pot of boiling water over medium heat, water reaching a third of their height.
instructions.5: Cover the pot with a clean towel then a lid.
instructions.6: Steam-bake for 3 hours.
instructions.7: After 3 hours, test the cake with a wooden skewer to check it is done.
instructions.8: Make the sauce by mixing a cup of dark chocolate with half a cup of hot skimmed milk.
instructions.9: Pour the sauce over the cakes.
instructions.10: Decorate with strawberry and kiwi pieces.

fah-647.title: Quick No-Oven Biscuit Cake
fah-647.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-647.culturalNotes: Add chocolate pieces or dried fruit for flavour.

instructions.1: Crush the biscuits finely.
instructions.2: Get the milk.
instructions.3: Add the flour to the crushed biscuits.
instructions.4: Add the cocoa, sugar and baking powder.
instructions.5: Mix until combined.
instructions.6: Pour into a microwave-safe bowl.
instructions.7: Microwave for exactly one minute.
instructions.8: Serve hot.

fah-648.title: Mango Jelly Cake
fah-648.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-648.culturalNotes: Serve with fresh mango or other fruit. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Beat the eggs with the vanilla and sugar until creamy.
instructions.2: Add the flour, baking powder and salt and stir until the flour disappears.
instructions.3: Pour into the prepared tin and bake at 170°C for 30 minutes.
instructions.4: Meanwhile whip the chantilly with the icing sugar, milk and mango-jelly pack until creamy.
instructions.5: Prepare the mango jelly in a bowl and cool.
instructions.6: Pour the syrup or honeyed water over the baked cake.
instructions.7: Spread the chantilly layer over the cake.
instructions.8: Add the mango pieces over the cream.
instructions.9: Pour the cooled jelly layer on top.
instructions.10: Refrigerate at least two hours.

fah-649.title: Ten-Minute No-Oven Cakes
fah-649.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-649.culturalNotes: Don't let the water boil hard or it will get into the moulds. Serve hot or cold.

instructions.1: Mix the egg with the vanilla and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the sugar and stir well.
instructions.3: Add the oil and milk and stir until combined.
instructions.4: Sift the flour and cocoa over the mix and stir until smooth.
instructions.5: Fill the cake moulds (small cups) halfway.
instructions.6: Tuck chocolate pieces into the centre of each mould.
instructions.7: Set the moulds in a tray with hot water halfway up.
instructions.8: Cover the tray with a towel then a lid over medium heat.
instructions.9: Cook for 10 minutes.
instructions.10: Uncover and cool slightly.
instructions.11: Decorate with icing sugar and cherries if you like.

fah-650.title: Fluffy Cornflour Cake
fah-650.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-650.culturalNotes: Preheat the oven to 170°C before starting. Serve with tea or milky tea.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, cornflour and baking powder in a bowl.
instructions.2: Blend the sugar, eggs, oil, vanilla, hot milk, vinegar and salt until the sugar dissolves.
instructions.3: Add the liquid mix gradually to the dry and stir until combined.
instructions.4: Pour into a 26 cm tin, greased with ghee or butter and floured.
instructions.5: Bake in a preheated 170°C oven.
instructions.6: Bake for 40–50 minutes until cooked.
instructions.7: Cool before cutting.

fah-651.title: Quick Nectarine Cake
fah-651.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-651.culturalNotes: Apples or oranges can replace the nectarines. Add a little cinnamon for flavour.

instructions.1: Pit the nectarine and slice thinly.
instructions.2: Lay it in an 18 cm non-stick tray.
instructions.3: Scatter 2 tablespoons of sugar over the fruit.
instructions.4: Mix 2 tablespoons of sugar, 2 of oil, ¾ cup of flour and ⅓ cup of milk in a bowl.
instructions.5: Pour the mixture over the nectarines.
instructions.6: Top with the nuts.
instructions.7: Set the tray over medium heat on the stove.
instructions.8: Cover until golden.
instructions.9: Serve hot or cold.

fah-652.title: Cold Summer Cake — No Oven, No Eggs
fah-652.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-652.culturalNotes: Leftover cake can replace the biscuit base. Serve cold with fresh fruit.

instructions.1: Pour the litre of milk into a pot.
instructions.2: Add half a cup of sugar, 3 tablespoons of raw cocoa and 3 of cornflour.
instructions.3: Stir well in the cold milk until dissolved.
instructions.4: Heat, stirring constantly, until boiling and thick.
instructions.5: Add the tin of ashta, the butter and the vanilla.
instructions.6: Keep stirring until the chocolate and butter melt.
instructions.7: Layer biscuits in a cheesecake tin.
instructions.8: Add a layer of the hot mousse.
instructions.9: Repeat to the last layer, finishing with mousse.
instructions.10: Cover and refrigerate at least 5 hours or overnight.
instructions.11: Decorate with grated dark chocolate and strawberries or cherries.

fah-653.title: One-Egg Cake
fah-653.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-653.culturalNotes: Add a quarter cup of extra sugar if you skip the cream caramel. Keeps in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Blend the egg.
instructions.2: Add the oil, vanilla, yogurt, sugar and vinegar and blend for 3–4 minutes.
instructions.3: Separately mix the flour, cornflour, cake-chef sachet, cream caramel (optional) and salt.
instructions.4: Add the liquids to the dry mix and stir until a batter forms.
instructions.5: Grease the tin with ghee and dust with flour.
instructions.6: Pour in the batter and level.
instructions.7: Bake in a preheated 170°C oven for 40 minutes.
instructions.8: Take the cake out of the oven after 40 minutes and test for doneness.
instructions.9: Cool before serving.

fah-654.title: Fluffy Moist Cake
fah-654.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-654.culturalNotes: Serve with mint tea or Nescafé. Keeps in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Heat the oven to 170°C.
instructions.2: Line a 30×40 cm tray with baking paper.
instructions.3: Blend the eggs, oil, vanilla, laban or yogurt, sugar and salt.
instructions.4: Add the flour, baking powder and coconut and mix until combined.
instructions.5: Pour into the prepared tray.
instructions.6: Bake for 20–25 minutes.
instructions.7: Soak the baked cake with the cold milk.
instructions.8: Cool, then cut into cubes.

fah-655.title: Laban Rayeb (Fermented Milk)
fah-655.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-655.culturalNotes: Use in doughs and pastries, or eat as a light snack with honey. Keep refrigerated once made.

instructions.1: Simmer the milk in a pot over low heat.
instructions.2: Once boiled, pour into a clean dish and cover.
instructions.3: Leave in the warm oven for 24 hours undisturbed.
instructions.4: After 24 hours, take the tagine out of the oven and leave it to cool.
instructions.5: Strain the laban in a wire sieve and sprinkle a teaspoon of salt on it.
instructions.6: Leave the laban in the sieve another day to drain.
instructions.7: Eat as is with honey, or use in doughs and pastries.

fah-656.title: Homemade Marshmallows
fah-656.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-656.culturalNotes: Cut into circles, stars or hearts. Keeps in an airtight container for up to a week.

instructions.1: Mix half a cup of water with 2 cups of fine sugar and the glucose syrup.
instructions.2: Add a drop of lemon juice and stir well.
instructions.3: Bring to the boil over medium heat and leave for 5 minutes.
instructions.4: Separately, mix the gelatin with half a cup of boiling water, whisking fast.
instructions.5: Add the gelatin mix to the sugar mix and stir well.
instructions.6: Pour into a plastic-lined, oiled square tray.
instructions.7: Level and cool for 10 minutes.
instructions.8: Set half aside and colour the rest as you like.
instructions.9: Chill fully for 30 minutes.
instructions.10: Dust a tray generously with cornflour and cut the marshmallow into small cubes.
instructions.11: Coat each cube in cornflour and sieve off the excess.

fah-657.title: Green-Apple Jam
fah-657.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-657.culturalNotes: Slice thinly or cube the apples. The gelatin helps the jam set in the fridge.

instructions.1: Slice or cube the green apples.
instructions.2: Put them in a pot with half a kilo of the sugar, half a cup of water and the lemon juice.
instructions.3: Stir, cover and bring to the boil over medium heat.
instructions.4: Keep simmering until it thickens and releases syrup.
instructions.5: Dissolve the gelatin in half a cup of water and set aside.
instructions.6: Halfway through, add the raisins and cinnamon and stir.
instructions.7: Simmer until fully thickened.
instructions.8: Add the dissolved gelatin and stir once on the heat.
instructions.9: Take off when ready.
instructions.10: Store in sterilised, sealed jars in the fridge.

fah-658.title: Carrot Jam with Apricots & Orange
fah-658.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-658.culturalNotes: Keeps a long time in a cool, dry spot. Always use a clean, dry spoon.

instructions.1: Wash and halve the oranges.
instructions.2: Juice and strain them in the food processor, removing seeds and peel.
instructions.3: Wash the carrots and slice thinly.
instructions.4: Grate the carrots in the processor.
instructions.5: Add the grated carrot and orange juice to a pot.
instructions.6: Add the sugar, cloves and apricots.
instructions.7: Bring to the boil, then lower and stir occasionally until thickened.
instructions.8: Take off the heat.
instructions.9: Store in clean, dry jars in a cool, dry spot.

fah-659.title: Strawberry Jam
fah-659.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-659.culturalNotes: Use ripe strawberries with no green parts for the best taste and colour. Keeps a long time in sterilised jars or freezer bags.

instructions.1: Wash the strawberries and chop small — some can be blended.
instructions.2: Add the sugar, stir, cover and refrigerate overnight.
instructions.3: Next day they'll have released lots of juice.
instructions.4: Put in a heavy-based pot over high heat and boil.
instructions.5: After a while, skim the foam that forms.
instructions.6: Keep boiling until the strawberries thicken.
instructions.7: Add the lemon juice and stir.
instructions.8: Drop a spoon on a plate, cool, and run a line through it — if it doesn't merge back, it's done.
instructions.9: Cool fully, then jar in sterilised, dry jars.
instructions.10: Seal and store somewhere cool and dry or in the fridge.

fah-660.title: Mahalabia with Filo
fah-660.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-660.culturalNotes: Any nuts at home work — peanuts or almonds. Syrup can replace the honey.

instructions.1: Cut the filo into small pieces on a tray.
instructions.2: Melt the ghee or butter and drizzle over the filo.
instructions.3: Bake on the middle shelf at 180°C until browned.
instructions.4: Put a kilo of milk on the heat.
instructions.5: Crush the mastic and add it to the milk.
instructions.6: Add the half cup of sugar and stir.
instructions.7: Separately, mix the cornflour with half a cup of milk.
instructions.8: Add the cornflour mix to the hot milk, stirring until thick.
instructions.9: Add the vanilla and ashta and stir.
instructions.10: Take the filo out and crush slightly.
instructions.11: Mix in the toasted nuts and a little honey or syrup.
instructions.12: In the serving dishes, layer toasted filo, mahalabia, then more filo.
instructions.13: Add more nuts on top if you like.

fah-661.title: Molto Croissants with Chocolate Sauce
fah-661.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-661.culturalNotes: Serve hot or cold. Keeps in the fridge for two days.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, yeast, baking powder and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the egg, vinegar and warm water gradually, kneading until combined.
instructions.3: Add the melted butter and knead for 5 minutes.
instructions.4: Cover with a cloth and prove in a warm spot for 30 minutes.
instructions.5: Oil the worktop and roll the dough into a circle.
instructions.6: Cut into small squares.
instructions.7: Shape each square into a croissant as shown in the video.
instructions.8: Set on an oiled tray and prove for 15 minutes.
instructions.9: Brush with the egg-and-milk mix and bake at 220°C for 10 minutes.
instructions.10: Stir the milk, sugar and cornflour over low heat until thick.
instructions.11: Add the crushed chocolate and butter and stir until melted.
instructions.12: Cool the sauce, then chill briefly.
instructions.13: Dip the croissants in the sauce or fill them with chocolate using a piping bag.

fah-662.title: Milkshake
fah-662.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-662.culturalNotes: Fresh banana works but frozen gives a thicker, colder shake.

instructions.1: Blend the frozen bananas.
instructions.2: Add the milk, vanilla and sugar.
instructions.3: Add the ice cream.
instructions.4: Blend until combined.
instructions.5: Pour into glasses.
instructions.6: Drizzle caramel sauce to taste.

fah-663.title: Naiti (Jam Layer Cake Bites)
fah-663.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-663.culturalNotes: Any jam works. Serve with tea or coffee.

instructions.1: Beat the eggs with the vanilla and sugar in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the oil gradually while beating.
instructions.3: Add the milk and keep beating until blended.
instructions.4: Add the flour, baking powder and salt and mix well.
instructions.5: Pour into a buttered tray or one lined with baking paper.
instructions.6: Bake in a preheated 170°C oven for 15 minutes.
instructions.7: Cool slightly.
instructions.8: Cut the cake in half and spread the jam on the bottom half.
instructions.9: Cover with the top half and press lightly.
instructions.10: Cut into small pieces.

fah-664.title: Homemade Nutella
fah-664.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-664.culturalNotes: Keeps in a jar in the fridge for over a month. Use in sandwiches or as a dessert sauce.

instructions.1: Toast the hazelnuts at 170°C for 10 minutes until golden.
instructions.2: Grind them in the blender until smooth.
instructions.3: Add the chopped chocolate to the blender.
instructions.4: Add the icing sugar, milk powder and raw cocoa.
instructions.5: Pour in the boiling water gradually.
instructions.6: Blend until smooth and pourable.
instructions.7: Pour into a clean, dry jar.

fah-665.title: Warbat with Cream
fah-665.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-665.culturalNotes: Add crushed hazelnuts or peanuts to the cream for extra flavour. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

fah-665-i4.name: Dessert cream or 2 tbsp milk-skin cream

instructions.1: Put 2 cups of cold milk in a pot over the heat.
instructions.2: Add 2 tablespoons of cornflour and stir until combined.
instructions.3: Keep stirring until boiling and thick.
instructions.4: Add the cream and stir until it melts in.
instructions.5: Take off and cool the cream.
instructions.6: Oil a baking tray and lay the puff pastry evenly.
instructions.7: Brush the tops with a little milk.
instructions.8: Bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes until golden.
instructions.9: Cool slightly, then split in half.
instructions.10: Fill with the cream using a piping bag or spoon.

fah-234.title: Winter Vegetable & Vermicelli Soup
fah-234.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-234.culturalNotes: Serve with toasted bread for a warmer, heartier bowl.

instructions.1: Heat the butter or oil in a pot.
instructions.2: Add the onion and garlic and stir until golden.
instructions.3: Add the diced carrots, ground cardamom, bay leaves and peas.
instructions.4: Cover and leave over low heat until they soften.
instructions.5: Add the courgette cubes, boiling water and the vegetable stock cube and stir well.
instructions.6: Leave on the heat until cooked.
instructions.7: In another pot, brown the vermicelli in a spoon of butter or oil.
instructions.8: Add the vermicelli to the pot with the vegetables and adjust the salt and pepper.
instructions.9: Add the chopped celery, cover and leave for 10 minutes off the heat.
instructions.10: Serve the soup hot with lemon juice.

fah-235.title: Chicken, Mushroom & Cream Soup
fah-235.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-235.culturalNotes: Tinned mushrooms can replace fresh. Instant stock instead of water gives a stronger flavour. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee in a pot.
instructions.2: Add the chopped onion and stir until golden.
instructions.3: Add the chicken pieces and sear with the onion until they start cooking.
instructions.4: Add the pepper, sugar, salt and ground cardamom and stir well.
instructions.5: Add the mushrooms and sear with the chicken and onion for a minute.
instructions.6: Add the flour and stir well.
instructions.7: Add a litre of water and boil for two minutes.
instructions.8: Add the cream, boil for a minute, then turn off the heat.
instructions.9: Skim the cream off the top of the milk if you'd rather use it as a cream substitute.

fah-236.title: Freekeh & Carrot Soup
fah-236.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-236.culturalNotes: Serve with toasted bread or sweet biscuits for a full meal. Keeps in the fridge for two days or freeze for longer.

instructions.1: Cut the chicken breasts into small cubes.
instructions.2: Wash the freekeh, soak for half an hour, then drain.
instructions.3: Grate the carrot and chop the celery and onion small.
instructions.4: Heat the butter and oil in a pot.
instructions.5: Add two mastic tears and sear the chicken until it starts cooking.
instructions.6: Add a pinch of sugar and stir the chicken well.
instructions.7: Add the onion and stir for a minute.
instructions.8: Add the celery and carrot and stir for a minute.
instructions.9: Add the salt, pepper, ground cardamom and freekeh.
instructions.10: Add the boiling water or instant stock.
instructions.11: Bring to the boil, then lower the heat and simmer for 15 minutes until cooked.

fah-237.title: Mushroom & Cream Soup
fah-237.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-237.culturalNotes: A stock cube strengthens the flavour. Serve with lemon juice for a distinct taste.

instructions.1: Cut the rabbit into small cubes.
instructions.2: Open and drain the tin of mushrooms.
instructions.3: Heat the ghee in a pot.
instructions.4: Add the rabbit pieces and sear until they change colour.
instructions.5: Add the chopped onion and sear with the rabbit.
instructions.6: Add the chopped garlic and stir in.
instructions.7: Add the celery and sear.
instructions.8: Add the mushrooms and stir in.
instructions.9: Add the flour and stir well.
instructions.10: Add the salt and black pepper.
instructions.11: Add the boiling water and let it boil.
instructions.12: Add the milk and stir well.
instructions.13: Leave on low heat until it boils and thickens.
instructions.14: Serve hot with toasted bread and chopped parsley.

fah-238.title: Pasta Soup
fah-238.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-238.culturalNotes: A complete, nutrient-rich meal served hot. Keeps in the fridge for two days or freeze for longer.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee and oil in a pot.
instructions.2: Add the chicken pieces and stir until golden.
instructions.3: Add the chopped onion and garlic and stir until golden.
instructions.4: Add the carrots, peas and sweetcorn and stir together.
instructions.5: Add boiling water (about 2 litres), the stock cube, salt, pepper and sugar and bring to the boil.
instructions.6: Cover and simmer over low heat until the vegetables cook.
instructions.7: In another pan, warm a teaspoon of ghee and a spoon of oil, add the pasta and stir until golden.
instructions.8: Add the browned pasta to the pot.
instructions.9: Add the celery, sweetcorn and tomato paste and stir.
instructions.10: Cover and simmer for 2 minutes until boiling.
instructions.11: Turn off the heat and rest the soup for 5–10 minutes before serving.

fah-239.title: Orzo Soup with Vegetables & Chicken
fah-239.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-239.culturalNotes: Serve hot with bread or as a main meal.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the chicken cubes and sear with the pepper, mastic and ground cardamom.
instructions.3: Add the chopped onion and stir until it wilts.
instructions.4: Add the peas and carrots and stir together.
instructions.5: Cover the pot and leave the vegetables for 2–3 minutes.
instructions.6: Add the courgette and potatoes and stir.
instructions.7: Add the water or broth and the stock cube and cover.
instructions.8: Cook the vegetables until done but not mushy.
instructions.9: Add the salt and the orzo and cover.
instructions.10: When the soup boils, turn off the heat.
instructions.11: Add the celery and cover for a minute.

fah-240.title: Homemade Cooking Cream
fah-240.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-240.culturalNotes: Keeps in the fridge for a week to ten days. Use it in sauces, soups and pasta.

instructions.1: Blend the milk, flour, ashta and sugar until smooth.
instructions.2: Pour into a pot over the heat, stirring constantly until boiling.
instructions.3: Strain through a fine sieve to remove lumps.
instructions.4: Pour into a container and refrigerate.

fah-241.title: Homemade Instant Stock Mix
fah-241.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-241.culturalNotes: Keep in an airtight jar in a dark spot away from heat to preserve the aroma and flavour.

instructions.1: Mix everything in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Warm over low heat, stirring for 5 minutes to drive off moisture.
instructions.3: Cool completely.
instructions.4: Grind in the spice mill until fine.
instructions.5: Store in an airtight jar in a dark spot away from heat.
instructions.6: Freeze extra in sealed bags.
instructions.7: Use a teaspoon at a time as needed.
instructions.8: Use it in soups, molokhia, sauces and other dishes.

fah-460.title: Easy Quick Bagasha
fah-460.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-460.culturalNotes: Serve bagasha with caramel sauce, chocolate or icing sugar. Keeps in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Make the syrup: mix the sugar and water in a pot and set over the heat.
instructions.2: Leave to boil for 5 minutes.
instructions.3: Add the juice of half a lemon, a teaspoon of vanilla and 2 tablespoons of white honey.
instructions.4: Boil once more, then turn off and cool the syrup.
instructions.5: Make the dough: mix the flour, cornflour and salt in a bowl.
instructions.6: Add the oil and vanilla and mix well.
instructions.7: Add the egg and water gradually until a smooth, cohesive dough forms.
instructions.8: Knead for at least 5 minutes.
instructions.9: Cut into 3 balls and rest for 15 minutes.
instructions.10: Roll out with cornflour to about 3 mm thick.
instructions.12: Fry the squares in hot oil over medium heat until golden.
instructions.14: Toss into the cold syrup, or dust with icing sugar, or drizzle caramel or chocolate over them.

fah-461.title: Nutella-Filled Donuts
fah-461.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-461.culturalNotes: Decorate with melted chocolate or any topping. The dough doesn't soak up much oil, so it's relatively light.

instructions.1: Dissolve the yeast with a spoon of sugar in warm water and leave for 10 minutes.
instructions.2: In another bowl, mix the flour with the remaining sugar, baking powder and salt.
instructions.3: Add the yogurt and mayonnaise to the flour and knead well.
instructions.4: Add the dissolved yeast and knead into a soft, elastic dough.
instructions.5: Cover and prove for 30 minutes.
instructions.6: Roll on a floured surface and cut into lemon-sized circles.
instructions.7: Cover again and rest for 5 minutes.
instructions.8: Roll pairs of circles to half a centimetre, put a little Nutella in the centre.
instructions.9: Seal well and cut with a round cutter.
instructions.10: Heat oil in a pot over medium heat and fry the donuts until golden.
instructions.11: Dust the fried donuts with icing sugar and cinnamon.

fah-462.title: Madla'a (Basbousa & Kunafa Layer Dessert)
fah-462.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-462.culturalNotes: The basbousa and kunafa must be completely cold before layering. Any basbousa you have works. Skip the nuts if you prefer.

instructions.1: Prepare the basbousa:
instructions.2: Toast the milk powder in a pan until golden.
instructions.3: Mix the semolina with the dry ingredients: salt, baking powder and coconut.
instructions.4: Add the warm ghee or oil and stir until it feels like damp sand.
instructions.5: Add the milk and white honey and stir until combined.
instructions.6: Grease a 26 cm tray with ghee and spread the basbousa mix.
instructions.7: Bake at 180°C until browned top and bottom.
instructions.8: Make the basbousa syrup by boiling the sugar and water.
instructions.9: Soak the basbousa with a third of the syrup.
instructions.10: Prepare the kunafa:
instructions.11: Mix the kunafa with the baladi ghee and icing sugar.
instructions.13: Soak the kunafa with the remaining quarter of the syrup.
instructions.15: Whip the raw chantilly with the icing sugar and cold milk for 5–7 minutes until thick.
instructions.16: Add the ashta and mix well.
instructions.18: Spread a layer of kunafa in the tin.
instructions.20: Crumble the basbousa over the cream.
instructions.21: Add a second layer of cream.

fah-463.title: Light Om Ali
fah-463.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-463.culturalNotes: Day-old filo works perfectly here. Serve hot or cold.

instructions.1: Spread two filo sheets, cut and arrange in a tray.
instructions.2: Drizzle the ghee over the filo.
instructions.3: Bake at 180°C for 20 minutes until golden.
instructions.4: Mix the milk with the sugar and vanilla well.
instructions.5: Pour the milk mix over the tray out of the oven.
instructions.6: Decorate with nuts, raisins, coconut and caramel sauce.
instructions.7: Serve hot.

fah-464.title: Basbousa with Water
fah-464.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-464.culturalNotes: Top with nuts to decorate. Serve with ice cream or ashta for a better taste.

instructions.1: Mix the half cup of sugar with 3 tablespoons of water and 2 of white honey or glucose over the heat until golden.
instructions.2: Add half a cup of ghee and a cup of water and stir until the sugar dissolves.
instructions.3: Take off the heat and set aside.
instructions.4: Toast 2 tablespoons of milk powder until golden and take off.
instructions.5: Add the 2 cups of semolina, quarter teaspoon of baking powder, a tablespoon of plain flour and 2 tablespoons of coconut and mix well.
instructions.6: Add the prepared syrup mix and stir until combined.
instructions.7: Pour into a size-28 tray greased with ghee or tahini and level.
instructions.8: Bake at 180°C for 30 minutes until golden.
instructions.9: Separately, boil 1½ cups of sugar with 1½ cups of water over low heat.
instructions.10: Add a tablespoon of ghee to the syrup and mix well.
instructions.11: Pour the hot syrup over the basbousa straight out of the oven and let it absorb.
instructions.12: Cut into pieces and serve hot or cold.
instructions.13: Top with nuts to decorate if you like.

fah-465.title: Caramelised Basbousa
fah-465.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-465.culturalNotes: Use coarse or medium semolina for the right texture. Stir rather than knead. Grease the tray with tahini and ghee for a nice taste and colour. The oven must be hot. Pour the hot syrup on the basbousa straight from the oven.

instructions.1: Warm a cup of sugar in a pan over low heat with two spoons of water until it dissolves.
instructions.2: Stir with a wooden spoon until golden.
instructions.3: Add two spoons of white honey and mix well.
instructions.4: Add a cup of ghee, 1½ cups of boiling water and a pinch of vanilla and mix.
instructions.5: Add 4 cups of semolina, 3 tablespoons of coconut, half a cup of milk powder, 2 tablespoons of plain flour and a quarter teaspoon of baking powder and mix well.
instructions.6: Grease a 40×50 cm tray with a spoon each of ghee and tahini.
instructions.7: Spread the mixture in the tray and level with a spoon.
instructions.8: Bake in a preheated 200°C oven for 30 minutes until golden.
instructions.9: Make the syrup by simmering 3 cups of sugar with 3 cups of water until dissolved.
instructions.10: Add a tablespoon of ghee to the syrup and mix well.
instructions.11: Pour the hot syrup over the basbousa straight out of the oven.
instructions.12: Cool for two to three hours — or an hour in the fridge — before cutting.

fah-466.title: Eid Biscuits
fah-466.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-466.culturalNotes: Add apricot and cherry jam on the round biscuits for decoration and extra taste. Keeps in an airtight container for up to a week.

instructions.1: Beat the icing sugar and butter until white and creamy.
instructions.2: Add the eggs one at a time, beating until absorbed.
instructions.3: Add the vanilla and milk and mix well.
instructions.4: In another bowl, mix the flour, salt and baking powder.
instructions.5: Add the dry mix to the wet and fold gently until combined.
instructions.6: Cover and refrigerate for 15 minutes.
instructions.7: Shape with a piping bag or by hand.
instructions.8: Lay on an oiled tray.
instructions.9: Bake in a preheated 170°C oven.
instructions.10: Bake for 15 minutes or until golden.

fah-467.title: Orange & Ammonia Eid Biscuits
fah-467.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-467.culturalNotes: Store in a sealed tin away from moisture to keep them crisp. Shape with a cloth piping bag or a biscuit press.

instructions.1: Beat the ghee in the mixer until creamy.
instructions.2: Add the sifted icing sugar and beat for 4–5 minutes until creamy.
instructions.3: Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each.
instructions.4: Add the orange vanilla, salt and baking powder and stir.
instructions.5: Add the milk with the baker's ammonia and stir well.
instructions.6: Add the sifted flour and cornflour and stir until combined.
instructions.7: Knead the dough by hand until soft.
instructions.8: Oil the baking tray and set the dough on it.
instructions.9: Bake at 180°C for 15 minutes.
instructions.10: Cool before serving.
